httpResponseTemplate.template: var params = request.queryStringParameters; var a = parseFloat(params.a ? params.a[0] : 0); var b = parseFloat(params.b ? params.b[0] : 0); var op = params.op ? params.op[0] : "+"; var result; switch(op) { case "+": result = a + b; break; case "-": result = a - b; break; case "*": result = a * b; break; case "/": result = b !== 0 ? a / b : "Error: Division by zero"; break; default: result = "Error: Invalid operation"; } return { statusCode: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": ["application/json"] }, body: JSON.stringify({ operation: a + " " + op + " " + b, result: result, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() }) };
